headlines.title: Europe's car makers are in crisis. Will the threat of war rescue them?
headlines.summary: Auto executives across Europe hope rearmament can help them flex their industrial muscles once more.

headlines.title: Spanish farmers demand urgent aid as war in Iran drives up costs
headlines.summary: Asaja, COAG, UPA, Unión de Uniones and the agri-food cooperatives are urging the government for direct aid over soaring farm diesel and fertiliser prices caused by the war in Iran, warning protests will go ahead if no action is taken.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Cybercriminal group claims to steal thousands of FBI employee records
headlines.summary: The FBI said it was probing a suspected hack, after the cybercriminal group ShinyHunters claimed to have breached its systems.

headlines.title: IMF tells advanced economies to 'bring debt down' as borrowing costs rise
headlines.summary: In an interview with the BBC, Kristalina Georgieva says economic shocks had pushed "debt levels up like a staircase not to heaven".

headlines.title: ECB calls for tougher EU crypto rules and wider ban on stablecoin interest
headlines.summary: Europe's central banks want the EU's crypto rules tightened, calling for a wider ban on interest payments on stablecoins, new powers to curb tokens pegged to foreign currencies such as the US dollar, and EU-level supervision of crypto firms.

headlines.title: Germany s car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
headlines.summary: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers rights.

headlines.title: Chinese president arrives in US with new energy leverage as war rattles global markets
headlines.summary: The Iran war has boosted China’s clean energy exports and strengthened its leverage in global energy markets, giving China little incentive to yield to President Donald Trump’s demands.

headlines.title: Trump says he would back ban on diesel exports
headlines.summary: Republicans lawmakers have put pressure on the president to curb exports as diesel prices soar to record highs in the US.

headlines.title: France’s budget: Oxfam targets ‘super-inheritances’ in tax plan
headlines.summary: As France hunts for billions of euros to repair its public finances, Oxfam is calling for tighter limits on a tax break for inherited family businesses, saying reform could raise more than €3bn a year.

headlines.title: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
headlines.summary: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.

headlines.title: British PM asks Trump to bring up Jimmy Lai with Xi
headlines.summary: The British delegation said the Hong Kong dissident could live in the United Kingdom, a person familiar with the situation said.

headlines.title: Sir Jim Ratcliffe suspends production at key UK plants blaming high gas prices
headlines.summary: Ineos said natural gas in the UK is twelve times more expensive than in the US.

headlines.title: One-bedroom flat rent in Portugal costs more than minimum wage
headlines.summary: Renting a one-bedroom flat costs a median €1,128 a month, 123% more than renting a room, which costs €505, according to property portal Idealista. Prices are highest in Lisbon, Faro and Madeira.

headlines.title: Trump talks peace, threatens annihilation of Iran in UNGA speech
headlines.summary: The speech mirrored the president’s approach to foreign policy throughout his second term.

headlines.title: New EU industry rules would damage UK, warns Burnham
headlines.summary: The prime minister met the European Commission President during his visit to the United Nations General Assembly.

headlines.title: EU seals Philippines trade deal in push to diversify away from China and US
headlines.summary: EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič said the deal with the Philippines would give EU businesses access to a market of 113 million consumers, strengthening the strategy to seek trade deals across the region.

headlines.title: Security-Update: Nukleare Abschreckung ohne die USA? – mit Claudia Major
headlines.summary: Präsentiert von Lockheed Martin.

headlines.title: Will a switch to light speed cut power use at data centres?
headlines.summary: To save power and add capacity, data centres are switching from copper wires to tech using light.

headlines.title: 'Made in Europe' battery rules could add €2,100 to electric car prices, report says
headlines.summary: Europe's strategy for its struggling car industry protects established manufacturers at the expense of consumers and taxpayers rather than helping them compete, according to a new report.

trend_headline: 이란 전쟁 여파와 자동차 위기 속 깊어지는 제조업 충격
summary: 이란 전쟁으로 인한 에너지 및 디젤 가격 폭등이 유럽 전역의 물류와 농업을 압박하는 가운데, 독일 등 주요국 자동차 산업은 구조적 위기와 노동시간 개편 갈등에 직면했습니다. 이와 함께 폭스바겐의 유로스톡스 50 지수 퇴출은 침체된 유로존 제조업의 위기감을 고스란히 반영하고 있습니다.
key_points: 폭스바겐(Volkswagen), 유로스톡스 50(Euro Stoxx 50) 지수에서 공식 퇴출
이란 전쟁 발발로 농업용 디젤 및 비료 가격 급등, 스페인 농민들 긴급 지원 촉구
독일 자동차 업계, 경쟁력 강화를 위해 기존 35시간 주당 근무제를 40시간으로 연장 요구하며 노조와 대립
